name: An app
title: A page, *and nothing declared twice*
lede: We add a Nuxt app in apps/nuxt with the @fougere/nuxt module and write a page. The page calls the blog by its name, and the fronds run inside Nuxt.
fig: The page names post and an operation. Its data, its form and its refusals are read from what you already wrote.

try.command: cd apps/nuxt && npm run dev   # then open localhost:3000/posts
try.output: a form with one field, title — and the posts, each with Publish

aside: Publish twice from two tabs: the second click shows Already published, the CONFLICT the handler throws.
install: npm create nuxt@latest apps/nuxt && cd apps/nuxt && npm install @fougere/nuxt
